symptom: PC gets IP but cannot reach server
topology_note: PC VLAN 30; gateway ping succeeds. Router output shows no route to 10.10.40.0/24.
show_outputs:
show ip route
C 10.10.30.0/24 is directly connected
C 10.10.20.0/24 is directly connected
expected_fault: Missing route to server VLAN 40

symptom: PC cannot get an IP address
topology_note: Access port is in VLAN 20. DHCP server is on VLAN 10.
show_outputs:
show vlan brief
20  Users  active
show interfaces vlan 20
Vlan20 is up, line protocol is up
expected_fault: Missing DHCP relay/helper on VLAN 20 SVI

symptom: Users in VLAN 30 cannot communicate with gateway
topology_note: Switch access port is assigned to VLAN 20 instead of VLAN 30.
show_outputs:
show vlan brief
20 Users active
30 Servers active
show interfaces fa0/7 switchport
Access Mode VLAN: 20
expected_fault: Wrong access VLAN on endpoint port

symptom: DNS name fails but IP ping works
topology_note: Client can ping 10.10.10.20 but nslookup fails.
show_outputs:
nslookup server.local
DNS request timed out
ipconfig /all
DNS Servers: 192.168.50.1
expected_fault: Incorrect or unreachable DNS server configured

symptom: Inter-VLAN ping fails
topology_note: Trunk connects switch to router. VLAN 30 traffic is not carried.
show_outputs:
show interfaces trunk
Vlans allowed on trunk: 10,20
show vlan brief
30 Servers active
expected_fault: VLAN 30 missing from trunk allowed list

symptom: Guest Wi-Fi can reach internal server
topology_note: Guest SSID maps to VLAN 50. ACL should block internal networks.
show_outputs:
show access-lists
Extended IP access list GUEST-IN
permit ip any any
expected_fault: Guest isolation ACL is missing/overly permissive

symptom: Only one workstation loses connectivity
topology_note: NIC is connected but switch interface is administratively down.
show_outputs:
show interfaces fa0/12 status
Fa0/12 disabled
expected_fault: Interface is administratively down

symptom: Clients receive 169.254.x.x addresses
topology_note: DHCP server is reachable from other VLANs, but client VLAN has no helper.
show_outputs:
show run interface vlan 60
interface Vlan60
 ip address 10.60.0.1 255.255.255.0
expected_fault: Missing ip helper-address on client VLAN

symptom: Server VLAN is unreachable after adding a switch
topology_note: New switch uplink is configured as access mode.
show_outputs:
show interfaces gi0/1 switchport
Administrative Mode: static access
Access Mode VLAN: 10
expected_fault: Uplink should be a trunk but is access mode

symptom: Remote network cannot be reached
topology_note: Static route points to an invalid next hop.
show_outputs:
show ip route 10.70.0.0
S 10.70.0.0/24 [1/0] via 10.1.1.99
show ip interface brief
G0/0 10.1.1.1 up up
expected_fault: Static route next hop is incorrect/unreachable

symptom: NAT clients cannot access Internet
topology_note: Inside interface is configured, outside interface is missing NAT role.
show_outputs:
show run interface g0/0
ip nat inside
show run interface g0/1
(no ip nat outside)
expected_fault: NAT outside interface role is missing

symptom: Port forwarding to web server fails
topology_note: NAT rule points to wrong inside local address.
show_outputs:
show ip nat translations
tcp 203.0.113.10:80 10.10.20.50:80
expected_fault: Static NAT maps to wrong server IP

symptom: DHCP clients get wrong gateway
topology_note: DHCP pool specifies another network gateway.
show_outputs:
show run | section dhcp
network 10.20.0.0 255.255.255.0
default-router 10.10.0.1
expected_fault: DHCP default-router does not match client subnet

symptom: Switch management IP is unreachable
topology_note: SVI is configured but VLAN is not active on the switch.
show_outputs:
show ip interface brief
Vlan99 10.99.0.2 up down
show vlan brief
99 Mgmt active
expected_fault: Management SVI line protocol is down

symptom: Router interface shows down/down
topology_note: Cable is connected in topology, but interface is shut down.
show_outputs:
show ip interface brief
G0/1 unassigned administratively down
expected_fault: Interface is administratively shutdown

symptom: Users can reach local VLAN but not remote VLAN
topology_note: Router-on-a-stick subinterface lacks encapsulation for VLAN 20.
show_outputs:
show run interface g0/0.20
interface G0/0.20
 ip address 10.20.0.1 255.255.255.0
expected_fault: Missing dot1Q encapsulation

symptom: ACL blocks legitimate HTTPS traffic
topology_note: ACL permits HTTP but not HTTPS.
show_outputs:
show access-lists
permit tcp any host 10.10.10.10 eq 80
den y ip any any
expected_fault: HTTPS/443 permit is missing before implicit deny

symptom: ACL change has no effect
topology_note: ACL was edited but not applied to interface.
show_outputs:
show run interface g0/0
(no ip access-group)
show access-lists
Extended IP access list EDGE-IN
expected_fault: ACL exists but is not bound to interface

symptom: Static route exists but packets still fail
topology_note: Route has correct destination but higher administrative distance than another path.
expected_fault: Static route loses to lower-distance dynamic route

symptom: Wireless clients connect but get no network access
topology_note: SSID is mapped to VLAN 70 but switch trunk allows only VLANs 10,20,30.
show_outputs:
show interfaces trunk
Vlans allowed: 10,20,30
show vlan brief
70 Guest active
expected_fault: Wireless VLAN missing from AP uplink trunk

symptom: AP management works but clients cannot join
topology_note: WPA2 key on controller/AP does not match client profile.
show_outputs:
show wireless client summary
Authentication failure
show run
ssid CampusWiFi
 security wpa2 key mismatch
expected_fault: Incorrect wireless security credentials

symptom: Duplicate IP causes intermittent connectivity
topology_note: Two devices use the same static IP in the server VLAN.
show_outputs:
show ip arp 10.10.20.15
10.10.20.15  aaaa.bbbb.cccc
10.10.20.15  dddd.eeee.ffff
expected_fault: Duplicate IP address detected

symptom: Host can ping gateway but not server
topology_note: Server has wrong subnet mask, placing it outside the intended subnet.
show_outputs:
show run interface g0/0
ip address 10.10.30.20 255.255.255.128
Expected server subnet: 10.10.30.0/24
expected_fault: Wrong subnet mask on server interface

symptom: Host has IP but gateway is unreachable
topology_note: Host default gateway is configured to a nonexistent address.
show_outputs:
ipconfig /all
IPv4 10.10.40.25
Mask 255.255.255.0
Gateway 10.10.40.254
show ip interface brief
Vlan40 10.10.40.1 up up
expected_fault: Default gateway mismatch

symptom: Trunk comes up but native VLAN warning appears
topology_note: Both ends use different native VLANs.
show_outputs:
show interfaces trunk
SW1 native VLAN 99
SW2 native VLAN 1
expected_fault: Native VLAN mismatch

symptom: Server is reachable by IP but web app fails
topology_note: TCP/80 is blocked while ICMP is permitted.
show_outputs:
show access-lists
permit icmp any host 10.10.10.20
den y tcp any host 10.10.10.20 eq 80
expected_fault: ACL blocks web application traffic

symptom: OSPF neighbor is not forming
topology_note: Interfaces are in different OSPF areas.
show_outputs:
show ip ospf neighbor
(no neighbors)
show ip ospf interface g0/0
Area 0
show ip ospf interface g0/1
Area 1
expected_fault: OSPF area mismatch between neighbors

symptom: DHCP pool is exhausted
topology_note: All addresses in the pool are leased.
show_outputs:
show ip dhcp pool USERS
Addresses in pool: 50
Leased: 50
Excluded: 0
expected_fault: DHCP address pool exhausted

symptom: Inter-VLAN routing works but return traffic fails
topology_note: Server-side default gateway points to an old router.
show_outputs:
show ip interface brief
Server VLAN gateway: 10.30.0.1
Server default gateway: 10.30.0.254
expected_fault: Server default gateway is incorrect

symptom: NAT overload configured but Internet still fails
topology_note: ACL used by NAT does not match the inside subnet.
show_outputs:
show run | include ip nat inside source
ip nat inside source list 10 interface g0/1 overload
show access-lists 10
permit 10.20.0.0 0.0.255.255
expected_fault: NAT ACL does not match actual inside subnet
